steps.text: Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season with salt and brush with 2 tbsp of the oil.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil and the butter in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 220C for 15 minutes until tender in the middle.
Wipe out the pan, cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy, stock and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the cauliflower steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.
Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season with salt and brush with 2 tbsp of the oil.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil and the butter in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 220C for 15 minutes until tender in the middle.
Wipe out the pan, cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the vinegar, water, stock and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the cauliflower steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

veg.n: Big Kahuna Hawaiian mushroom and haloumi burger
veg.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and grill them gill side down for 4 minutes, then flip, press flat and cook 4 minutes more, brushing with the teriyaki.
Grill the haloumi slices for 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and sit one on each mushroom. Top with the cheddar to melt.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, mushroom and haloumi, and pineapple.

veg_af.n: Big Kahuna Hawaiian mushroom and haloumi burger
veg_af.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, rice vinegar and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and grill them gill side down for 4 minutes, then flip, press flat and cook 4 minutes more, brushing with the teriyaki.
Grill the haloumi slices for 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and sit one on each mushroom. Top with the cheddar to melt.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, mushroom and haloumi, and pineapple.
Dice the onion, capsicum and mushrooms.
Fry the onion, capsicum and mushrooms in the oil until browned.
Add the lentils, tomato sauce, soy sauce, sugar, mustard, paprika and a splash of water. Simmer until thick, mashing some of the lentils with the back of a spoon.
Toast the buns and pile the lentil mix on.
Cut the potatoes into chunks and parboil for 8 minutes.
Toss the potatoes with 3 tbsp of the oil, the rosemary and salt and roast at 220C until crisp.
Brush the mushrooms with the remaining oil, the garlic and salt, then sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side. Keep warm.
Add the stock, balsamic, blueberries, sugar and thyme to the pan and simmer until syrupy, then whisk in the butter.
Slice the mushrooms thickly, spoon over the sauce and serve with the potatoes.
Bake the hash browns at 220C until crisp.
Halve the tomatoes and grill until soft.
Rub the mushrooms with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper and sear in a hot pan for 4 minutes a side, pressing them down.
Fry the eggs sunny side up in the butter and place one on each mushroom.
Trim the cauliflowers, boil them whole for 6 minutes, then drain and leave to steam dry.
Rub the cauliflowers with the oil, salt, half the garlic crushed and the thyme. Sit them on a tray with the carrots, chickpeas, the rest of the garlic cloves and the halved lemon.
Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then brush the cauliflowers with the honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky.
Squeeze the roasted lemon into the yoghurt. Cut the cauliflowers into wedges and serve with the carrots, chickpeas and yoghurt.

veg.n: Frost family nut roast and Yorkshires
veg.make_ahead: Nut roast mix up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus 1 tbsp for the gravy

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the olive oil until dry. Mix with the nuts, breadcrumbs, cheddar, 2 of the eggs, the mustard, rosemary and salt and press into a lined loaf tin.
Toss the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the vegetable oil. Roast the nut roast at 200C with the potatoes and the honey-tossed carrots on another tray.
Rest the nut roast in its tin and turn the oven to 220C. Whisk the other 2 eggs, the flour and milk into a batter.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the holes of a muffin tin, pour in the batter and bake without opening the oven.
Cook the spoon of flour in a little fat from the potato tray, then whisk in the stock and soy and simmer into gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Rest 10 minutes, open at the table

steps.text: Toss the eggplant, zucchini, capsicum, potatoes and tomatoes with the garlic, oregano, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Pile onto a large sheet of baking paper in a roasting dish, sit the feta on top and wrap tightly, then cover with foil.
Roast at 180C until the potatoes are very soft.
Rest, then open at the table so the steam rises.

veg.n: Gloucester mushroom, leek and smoky chickpea pie
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake the pastry fresh

steps.text: Quarter the mushrooms and dice the leeks and carrots.
Fry the chickpeas in 1 tbsp of the oil with the smoked paprika until crisp and set aside.
Brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil, then add the leeks and carrots and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then add the stock, cream, thyme and chickpeas and simmer.
Pour into a pie dish, top with the pastry and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas in butter and serve alongside.

veg.n: Far Far Away royal stuffed roast pumpkin
veg.make_ahead: Stuffing up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkins, halved lengthways and seeded

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil and half the salt and roast for 20 minutes.
Rub the pumpkin halves with 1 tbsp of the oil and the rest of the salt and roast cut side up next to the potatoes for 35 minutes.
Fry the onion and chopped sage in the remaining oil, then mix with the breadcrumbs, walnuts and feta.
Pile the stuffing into the pumpkin hollows and roast 20 minutes more until golden and tender.
Rest for 5 minutes, then carve and serve with the potatoes and apple sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Soak the cauliflower in the buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 1 hour.
Season the flour with the salt and paprika and dredge the cauliflower twice.
Heat the oil to 170C.
Fry in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until deep golden and tender.
Pile high on a platter.

veg.n: Pete's Diner smoky mushroom club sandwich

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the soy, paprika and maple syrup until dark and crisp at the edges.
Fry the smoked tofu slices in the same pan for 2 minutes a side.
Toast the bread.
Layer smoked tofu, mushrooms, lettuce, sliced tomato and mayo across three slices for each sandwich.
Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips.

veg.n: Flaming Dragon green curry with tofu
veg.make_ahead: Curry up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2cm cubes.
Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until it splits.
Add the tofu, the rest of the coconut milk, soy sauce, palm sugar, eggplant and beans. Simmer for 12 minutes.
Cook the rice by the absorption method.
Stir through the Thai basil and serve over rice.

veg.n: Croquet lawn mushroom and leek pie

ingredients.item: sheet puff pastry (or 2 for a deeper lid)

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches with salt and pepper, then set aside. Slice the leeks.
Soften the leeks in the same pan.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme. Return the mushrooms, add the beans and simmer until thick.
Pour into a pie dish and top with the pastry, pressing the edges down.
Bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2cm cubes. Slice the onion, capsicum and garlic.
Toss the tofu in the soy, then in the cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in the oil in a very hot wok until crisp, then lift out.
Stir-fry the onion, capsicum and garlic in the same wok.
Return the tofu, finish with the mushroom oyster sauce and cracked black pepper and serve over the rice.

veg.n: Eduardo's black bean and sweet potato enchiladas

steps.text: Toast the chillies in a dry pan, soak in hot water, then blend with the tomatoes.
Toss the sweet potato with the oil and cumin and roast at 220C until soft.
Simmer the sweet potato and black beans in a third of the sauce, lightly crushing them.
Roll the filling in the tortillas and place in a dish.
Cover with the rest of the sauce and grated cheddar.
Bake at 190C.
Serve with sour cream.

veg.n: San Francisco mushroom and butter bean cioppino with garlic toast
veg.make_ahead: Base up to 2 days, add the mushrooms and beans fresh

ingredients.item: king oyster mushrooms, cut into thick rounds

steps.text: Soften the fennel, onion and sliced garlic in 3 tbsp of the oil with the chilli.
Add the tomatoes, stock and torn nori and simmer.
Sear the mushroom rounds in the remaining oil in a hot pan until golden.
Add the mushrooms, butter beans and zucchini to the pot and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir through the parsley.
Toast the sourdough, rub with the cut garlic clove and serve alongside.

veg.n: Family dinner lemon and rosemary haloumi traybake

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in half the oil and salt on a large tray and roast for 20 minutes.
Toss the chickpeas with the lemon zest, garlic, rosemary and the rest of the oil, add to the tray and roast 10 minutes.
Lay the haloumi over the top and roast 12 minutes until golden. Squeeze over the lemon juice.
Boil the beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter.
Soak the kombu and dried shiitake in the water.
Slice the firm tofu, tofu puffs, king oyster mushrooms thinly lengthways, wombok, enoki and spring onions and arrange on platters.
Mix the soy, lemon juice and rice vinegar into a ponzu.
Cook the rice.
Bring the broth to a simmer at the table. Swish the tofu, mushrooms and vegetables through the broth and dip in the ponzu.

veg.make_ahead: Cooks well a day ahead, reheat gently

ingredients.item: 565g cans young green jackfruit in brine, drained

steps.text: Squeeze the jackfruit dry and pull it apart with your fingers. Tear the mushrooms into strips.
Mix the achiote with the juice of the oranges and 2 limes, the crushed garlic, cumin, oregano, oil and half the salt and coat the jackfruit and mushrooms.
Marinate for 2 hours in the fridge.
Wrap in banana leaves and then foil and roast at 180C for 1 hour, opening the parcel for the last 15 minutes.
Slice the red onion and quick pickle it in the juice of the last lime and the rest of the salt.
Shred the filling with two forks and serve with the pickled onion and warm tortillas.
Cook the flour in oil, then stir in the chilli powder and cumin.
Add the stock gradually with the soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Roll the tortillas around cheese and diced onion and lay in a dish.
Pour over the gravy and scatter with more cheese.
Bake at 190C until bubbling.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the celeriac up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Rub the celeriac with 1 tbsp of the oil, the salt, garlic and rosemary and wrap each in foil.
Roast at 200C for 1 hour.
Unwrap the celeriac, dot with the butter and add the potatoes, cut in chunks and tossed in the rest of the oil. Roast 50 minutes, basting twice, until deep golden.
Mix the horseradish into the sour cream.
Rest, then carve thick at the candlelit table with the horseradish cream.

veg.n: Camp oven mushroom and lentil stew
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes into chunks.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a heavy pot in batches.
Add the vegetables, lentils, stock, soy and rosemary, cover and cook over coals or at 160C until the lentils are tender.
Finish with chopped parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Butter up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Thread the haloumi and zucchini onto skewers.
Melt the butter with the garlic, chilli, zest of one lemon and parsley.
Brush the skewers with the butter and grill for 2 minutes a side.
Toss the cos and cucumber with lemon juice and oil. Serve with the skewers and crusty bread for the butter.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the chipotle in adobo, crushed garlic, the juice of 2 limes, the cumin, oil and half the salt.
Toss the cauliflower in the marinade and leave for 15 minutes.
Slice the red onion thin and soak in the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of the salt for 20 minutes.
Roast the cauliflower at 230C until charred at the edges.
Mash the avocados with the last lime and the rest of the salt.
Warm the tortillas and fill with avocado, cauliflower, onion and coriander.

veg.n: Napoleon's mushroom and butter bean Marengo
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the portobello slices in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the button mushrooms, wine, tomatoes and stock.
Return the portobellos, add the butter beans, cover and simmer.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.

veg_af.n: Napoleon's mushroom and butter bean Marengo

steps.text: Brown the portobello slices in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the button mushrooms, vinegar, water, tomatoes and stock.
Return the portobellos, add the butter beans, cover and simmer.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the bread.

veg.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, brush with egg and bake when needed

ingredients.item: large butternut pumpkin, neck only, peeled

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin neck lengthways, rub with 1 tbsp of the oil and salt and roast at 200C until just tender. Cool, then brush with the Dijon.
Cook the mushrooms and thyme leaves in the remaining oil until completely dry, stir in the soy and cool.
Wilt the spinach and squeeze dry. Lay it on plastic wrap, spread with the mushrooms, sit the pumpkin halves together on top and roll up tightly. Chill the roll.
Wrap in puff pastry and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200C until deep golden.
Rest before slicing.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

ingredients.item: extra virgin olive oil, plus a little extra
king oyster mushrooms, shredded with a fork

steps.text: Cook the linguine in well salted water.
Toast the breadcrumbs in a little oil until golden. Set aside.
Fry the mushrooms in half the oil until golden, then add the rest of the oil, the garlic and chilli for 2 minutes.
Add the nori, lemon zest and juice, butter and a ladle of pasta water and warm through.
Toss with the drained pasta and parsley, then scatter with the crumbs.
Slice the red onion thin and soak in the red wine vinegar with the sugar for 20 minutes.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and soy and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then slice thickly.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and salt.
Split the baguettes lengthways, spread with the horseradish cream and layer with the mushrooms, a handful of rocket, the drained onion and the fried shallots.
Press down and cut each into pieces.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Cook the penne and drain.
Sear the mushrooms in the oil until golden.
Add the garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, then the cream, and simmer.
Wilt in the spinach and toss through the penne with parmesan.
Boil the cauliflowers whole for 6 minutes, drain, then rub with the butter, salt and thyme leaves.
Toss the potatoes in oil and put them in the oven at 200C with the cauliflowers. Toss the carrots in the honey ready to add.
Roast for 45 minutes, adding the carrots part way through and brushing the cauliflowers with the maple syrup mixed with Dijon for the last 15 minutes.
Rest the cauliflowers.
Cook the flour in a little oil from the potato tray, then whisk in the stock and soy for gravy.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, season with the salt and pepper and roast at 220C for 20 minutes.
Simmer the stock with the soy, crushed garlic and oregano into a jus.
Slice the mushrooms thin.
Warm the mushrooms gently in the jus.
Pile into the rolls, dip briefly in the jus and top with giardiniera.

veg.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and layer in a dish with the cream, crushed garlic and salt.
Bake the gratin at 200C for 40 minutes.
Mash the butter with chopped tarragon and salt and spread it into the gills of the mushrooms.
Roast the mushrooms on the top shelf for 20 minutes while the gratin finishes.
Pour the wine, stock and Dijon into the mushroom tray, scrape and reduce by half in a pan.
Steam the beans and serve.

veg_af.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and layer in a dish with the cream, crushed garlic and salt.
Bake the gratin at 200C for 40 minutes.
Mash the butter with chopped tarragon and salt and spread it into the gills of the mushrooms.
Roast the mushrooms on the top shelf for 20 minutes while the gratin finishes.
Pour the verjuice, stock and Dijon into the mushroom tray, scrape and reduce by half in a pan.
Steam the beans and serve.
Pat the tofu dry, cut into 2cm cubes and toss in the potato starch.
Start the rice and cook until fluffy.
Fry the tofu in 180C oil in batches, drain, then fry a second time until crisp.
Fry the chillies, crushed garlic and grated ginger in a hot wok, then add soy, vinegar, sugar and stock.
Toss the tofu through the sauce and serve over rice.
Cook the onions in butter over low heat until soft and golden.
Rub the mushrooms with the oil and garlic, sear hard for 4 minutes a side pressing them flat, then slice.
Mix the mayonnaise with the horseradish.
Toast the sourdough, spread with mayo, pile on mushrooms and onions, top with Swiss and grill until melted.

veg.n: Chickpea, pumpkin, olive and lemon tagine
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the onion, grate the ginger, chop the preserved lemon and cut the pumpkin.
Soften the onion in the oil with the ginger and saffron.
Add the pumpkin, chickpeas, stock, preserved lemon and olives, cover and simmer until the pumpkin is tender.
Cover the couscous with the boiling water until fluffy, then fork through.
Serve the tagine over the couscous.

ingredients.item: large celeriac, peeled and cut into 8 slices 1cm thick

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes and slice.
Simmer the celeriac slices in salted water for 6 minutes until just tender, drain and pat dry.
Fry the mushrooms with the paprika in 2 tbsp of the oil until crisp, add the vinegar, mustard and stock and toss through the warm potatoes with chives.
Coat the celeriac in the flour, the beaten eggs and the breadcrumbs.
Fry in the butter and the rest of the oil for 3 minutes a side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs.
Serve with lemon and cranberry jam.

veg.n: Rivera family mushroom and bean enchiladas
veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Soak the chillies, blitz with the garlic and stock and simmer into a sauce.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned, then add the beans, cumin and a splash of the sauce.
Dip the tortillas in sauce, roll with the filling and some cheese, then cover with sauce and the rest of the cheese.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream and onion.
Cut the eggplants into 1.5cm slices, sprinkle with the salt, leave 15 minutes and pat dry.
Dip in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Bake the chips as the packet says.
Shallow fry the schnitzels until golden on each side.
Serve with lemon wedges, chips and a green salad.

veg.n: Swap your boss double black bean cheeseburgers

ingredients.item: chopped dill pickles, plus slices to serve
400g cans black beans, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil with the soy, half the paprika and the maple syrup until dark and crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, mustard and chopped pickles into a sauce.
Mash the beans with the breadcrumbs, egg, cumin, salt and the rest of the paprika and shape into 8 thin patties.
Fry the patties in the remaining oil for 3 minutes a side, then top with cheese to melt.
Stack two patties in each toasted bun with the smoky mushrooms, pickles, onion and sauce.
Simmer the stock with the dried shiitake, ginger and soy for 15 minutes, then add the sliced fresh shiitake for 5 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Cook the egg noodles and divide into bowls, add the halved bok choy blanched in the broth, ladle over the broth and top with halved eggs and sliced spring onion.

veg.n: Nacho's smoky chickpea and potato tacos
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

ingredients.item: can chickpeas, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Fry the potatoes and onion in the oil until golden.
Add the chickpeas, garlic, paprika, cumin, oregano and chilli and fry until crisp, then splash in the vinegar.
Quickly pickle the extra onion in lime juice.
Warm the tortillas.
Spoon the filling into the tortillas with avocado, pickled onion and coriander.
Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower and season with salt and the cracked pepper.
Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss in 2 tbsp of the oil and salt and roast at 220C until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower in the rest of the oil in a smoking cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme, baste, then finish in the oven for 10 minutes until tender.
Serve the steaks with the potatoes and the pan butter.
Score the eggplant flesh, brush with 4 tbsp of the oil and the salt and roast cut side up at 220C for 20 minutes.
Top with lemon slices, sliced garlic, capers and 1 tbsp of the oil and roast 10 minutes more.
Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and toss with the butter, parsley and dill.
Whisk the Dijon, vinegar and remaining oil and toss through the leaves.
Crumble the feta over the eggplant and serve with the potatoes and salad.

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkins, halved lengthways and seeded
can chickpeas, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Score the pumpkin flesh and rub with 2 tbsp of the oil, the salt and fennel seeds.
Roast at 200C cut side up.
Brush with the honey, add the apple halves and the chickpeas tossed in the rest of the oil and roast 25 minutes more.
Blast at 240C until the edges and chickpeas are golden and crisp.
Rest, then serve with the yoghurt.
Sweat the leeks and potatoes in the butter.
Add the stock and simmer.
Stir in the watercress for a minute.
Blitz until bright green.
Finish with the cream.
Rub the mushrooms with 1 tbsp of the oil and the garlic, sear hard in a hot pan for 4 minutes a side, then rest.
Toss the cos with the tomatoes and onion.
Whisk the vinegar, the rest of the oil and Dijon.
Slice the mushrooms thick and arrange over the salad with dressing and blue cheese.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into 8 balls.
Fry the potatoes once at a low heat, then again until crisp.
Smash the balls thin on a smoking oiled griddle, flip and top with cheese.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles, onion, sauce and mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and slice the capsicums and onions.
Fry the potatoes in oil until golden, then add the capsicums and onions and cook until soft.
Fry the vegetarian sausages until blistered.
Split the pizza bread rounds, fill with sausages and the potato and pepper mix and finish with mustard.

veg.n: Mirror room char siu tofu with fried rice
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2cm thick slabs.
Mix the hoisin, soy, honey, five spice and Shaoxing and coat the tofu.
Marinate for at least 2 hours.
Roast at 200C on a lined tray, glazing twice with the leftover marinade.
Fry the rice in the oil with the eggs and spring onion.
Slice the tofu over the rice.

veg_af.n: Mirror room char siu tofu with fried rice

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2cm thick slabs.
Mix the hoisin, soy, honey, five spice, stock and rice vinegar and coat the tofu.
Marinate for at least 2 hours.
Roast at 200C on a lined tray, glazing twice with the leftover marinade.
Fry the rice in the oil with the eggs and spring onion.
Slice the tofu over the rice.

veg.n: Mushroom and stout stew over mash
veg.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: field and Swiss brown mushrooms, thickly sliced

steps.text: Chop the onions and carrots.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots in the same pot, then stir in the flour.
Add the mushrooms, stout, stock, soy and lentils and simmer until thick.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Serve over the mash with crusty bread on the side.

veg_af.n: Mushroom and stout stew over mash
veg_af.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: field and Swiss brown mushrooms, thickly sliced

steps.text: Chop the onions and carrots.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots in the same pot, then stir in the flour.
Add the mushrooms, all the stock, malt vinegar, soy and lentils and simmer until thick.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Serve over the mash with crusty bread on the side.
Score the eggplant flesh and rub with the juice of 2 lemons, crushed garlic, oregano, 4 tbsp of the oil and salt.
Roast cut side up at 200C with the chickpeas scattered around until soft and golden.
Rest for 5 minutes.
Chop the tomatoes and cucumber and toss with feta, the rest of the oil and the last lemon.
Serve the eggplant and chickpeas with the salad.

veg.n: Ocean voyage tofu in banana leaf

steps.text: Marinate the tofu in some of the coconut milk with lime juice, chilli and soy.
Soften the banana leaves over a flame or in hot water.
Wrap each slab in a leaf with a spoon of the marinade.
Grill the parcels.
Cook the rice in the remaining coconut milk with the water and salt.
Serve the tofu in its leaf.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, wrapped

steps.text: Split the rolls and spread with mayonnaise and mustard.
Fill with smoked tofu, Swiss, lettuce and tomato and season with salt and pepper.
Wrap each tightly in paper and cut in half.
Juice the limes and orange, mix with the crushed garlic, cumin, oil and salt and coat the mushrooms.
Leave to marinate.
Grill very hot for 4 minutes a side.
Rest the mushrooms, then chop.
Dice the onion and warm the tortillas.
Serve in doubled tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa verde.
Toss the eggplant in the oil and roast at 220C until soft and golden.
Simmer the soy, honey, sugar and ginger until syrupy.
Brush the eggplant with the glaze.
Grill until sticky.
Steam the rice and cook the bok choy.

veg.n: Army mess lentil and mushroom roast
veg.make_ahead: Rest 10 minutes before slicing

steps.text: Fry the onion, mushrooms and carrot in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry. Mix with the mashed lentils, breadcrumbs, eggs, cheddar, tomato paste, soy and salt and press into a lined loaf tin.
Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the loaf with the potatoes and pumpkin tossed in the rest of the oil.
Rest the loaf in its tin.
Cook the peas.
Stir the flour into the oil left in the roasting tin, add the stock and simmer into gravy.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Toss the capsicum with the paprika and oil.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Top with sauce, mozzarella, capsicum, jalapeños, olives and mushrooms.
Bake until the crust blisters. Cut into squares.
Dice the onion, celery and potatoes and cut the corn off the cobs.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter with the paprika until crisp, lift out half for the top, then add the onion and celery.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer.
Add the corn for 5 minutes, then stir in the cream and thyme. Blitz a cup of the chowder and stir it back in.
Hollow and toast the sourdough rounds, ladle in the chowder and top with the saved mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Garlic butter up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: butternut pumpkins, peeled, halved lengthways and seeded

steps.text: Rub the potatoes with the oil and half the salt and bake at 200C.
Lay the pumpkin halves flat side down and cut thin slices most of the way through.
Brush with the butter mixed with the garlic and the rest of the salt and roast with the potatoes, brushing twice, until tender and golden.
Mix the horseradish into the sour cream.
Carve thick and serve with the potatoes, sour cream and chives.

veg.n: And then? Lemon cauliflower and fried rice

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice the day before and chill.
Dip the cauliflower in 2 of the eggs, beaten, then toss in most of the cornflour.
Shallow fry at 180C for 5 minutes until crisp and tender.
Simmer the juice of the lemons, the caster sugar, the water and the rest of the cornflour until glossy, and pour over.
Fry the cold rice in a hot wok with the last egg scrambled, the peas, the soy and the spring onions.
Stir-fry the broccoli with the garlic for 3 minutes.
Fry the paneer in the oil until golden and set aside.
Soften the onion with grated ginger and garlic in the same pan.
Add the garam masala, tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer.
Cook the basmati.
Stir in the paneer, cream and kasoori methi.
Warm the naan.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Score the mushrooms and marinate for 1 hour in the juice of the limes and orange, the crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt.
Grill hot for 3 minutes a side and slice thin.
Serve with the warm flour tortillas and the salsa.
Fry the diced onion, garlic and walnuts in the oil until browned, then add the lentils and fry hard.
Stir in cumin, paprika and tomato paste, then loosen with stock and simmer.
Warm the taco shells and prepare grated cheddar, lettuce and tomato.
Spoon into shells with toppings and sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 in the water and 2 crushed for the butter

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water with the paprika, garlic, lemon and nori.
Add the corn and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, zucchini and sausages for 4 minutes.
Drain, tip onto paper and pour over melted butter mixed with the crushed garlic.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Cut the pastry into squares, shape into cases and bake at 200C until puffed.
Fry the mushrooms in the butter until golden, then add the capsicum.
Stir in the flour, then the cream, stock and butter beans, and simmer until thick.
Spoon into the pastry cases.
Peel and cut the potatoes, chop the parsley and pat the haloumi dry.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, drain and toss with some of the butter, the parsley and pepper.
Dust the haloumi in the flour and pan-fry in butter until golden on both sides.
Cook the peas, then toss with butter and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve everything together.

veg.n: Lion versus tuna sesame tofu bowls

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice and season with 3 tbsp of the rice vinegar and the sugar.
Pat the tofu dry, brush with a little of the soy and press into the sesame seeds.
Sear in the hot oil for 2 minutes a side until golden and slice.
Whisk the rest of the soy and rice vinegar with the sesame oil and wasabi.
Boil the frozen edamame 3 minutes.
Build bowls with rice, tofu, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and spoon over the dressing.

veg.n: Sichuan pepper mushrooms and egg fried rice
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

ingredients.item: oyster mushrooms, torn into large pieces

steps.text: Tear the mushrooms and pat dry.
Toss in rice flour, Sichuan pepper and salt.
Fry at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp, then toss with chilli and half the spring onion.
Scramble the eggs in the 2 tbsp of oil, then fry the rice with the eggs and the rest of the spring onion.
Serve together.
